sections.what_happened: Netanyahu: 'Iran wanted to destroy us; we stopped them... Yet they persist. Therefore, there is only one way to end this: by toppling this regime. This is the directive I have issued to the IDF, to the Mossad, and to all our security branches' — no when/how specified. Earlier (Oct 20) said he discussed overthrowing Iran's government with Trump on Sunday. FT: Netanyahu instructed military to plan resumed strikes earlier this month; Trump objected. Trump: no restart before US midterms. Defense Minister Katz same day: Iran 'at its weakest point ever'; 'If Iran attacks Israel, Iran will burn!'
sections.what_verified: AFP; Arab News; Al Arabiya; L'Orient; IANS; Reuters; FMT — consistent quote across wires
sections.what_disputed: Analysts (Reuters): nothing short of US-Israeli ground invasion could force Tehran to abandon core security interests; Iran betting it can outlast; Israel election Oct 27 — Eisenkot-led opposition may not share war policy; Trump publicly opposed resumed strikes; 'directive' could be election-posturing — no execution timeline
sections.why_matters: Six days before the election, Netanyahu turns 'toppling Iran' into an IDF/Mossad directive — Trump reportedly objected to a strike plan days earlier
sections.context: Background: Israel/Iran — NEW: Netanyahu at Dimona election rally: 'only way to end' Iran threat is 'toppling this regime'; issued directive to IDF/Mossad/security branches
